method: Recursive embedded SDNA field offsets over every structured block instance and embedded structure/array; every fixed char array including its complete NUL tail; compare exact whole buffers with an actual newly saved --factory-startup Blender file, then narrowly declared public names/settings with full tail checking. No prefix-only grep or field-name-only path scan.
scope: Declared non-pointer fixed arrays of char/uchar/int8_t/uint8_t; raw pointer allocations, float geometry, and media are separate native/artifact checks.
